fact: On 23 October 2025 the NIU coordinator said the NIU database holds over 600,000 individuals and 28,000 legal entities, enrolled biometrically in Brazzaville and Pointe-Noire, with interfaces to ETAX (taxes) and SYDONIA (customs) still being completed.
